# Implementation plan

ID: PLAN-<feature>-<iteration>
Status: Proposed
Owner: Yoshikemolo
Feature / scenarios / ADRs / SEC controls: list exact IDs.

## Problem and acceptance
State user outcome, current behavior, intended behavior and independent oracle.

## Scope and design
List affected packages, API/events, persistence, UI, security and performance budgets.
State explicit exclusions for this slice and capability flags.

## Work sequence
Describe reviewable steps with a test boundary and evidence after each step.

## Failure and migration
Describe concurrency, retry, cancellation, corruption, upgrades and rollback/forward repair.

## Validation and handoff
Record commands, source SHA, report locations, limitations, owner review and next task.
